blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Presiding officer Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero told the Senate impeachment clerk of court to remove and edit the “inappropriate” fire transition effects from the records that appeared while Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano was leading the opening prayer for the trial. The fiery effects, photos and video clips of which have since gone viral, appeared on the livestream of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial at 10:03 a.m. while Cayetano was praying with his eyes closed.
